outline.heading: Profit and money in the account are different things

points.text: Honest profit counts everything at once, as if the retreat had already happened.
The first payment is the hardest moment for a new leader.

outline.heading: The gap in the teaching deal

points.text: In the teaching deal the venue gets 25 % at signing and the balance in installments up to a final payment 60 days before.
One rule closes almost everything: book the venue once first payments from the minimum group are in.
